rv.q: To Have and To Hold is an enjoyable and meaningful evening at the theatre — a must-see in this season at Hull Truck Theatre.
If its resolution could have more bite, its musings on an abandoned generation would leave plenty to chew over.
This fabulous production, a regional premiere, is the perfect ending to Hull Truck’s “Made in Hull” summer season.
This is definitely must-see production, a five-star show by a five-star cast.

cn.t: Richard Bean's bittersweet comedy earns widespread praise for its emotional range and sharp wit, with critics hailing the stellar performances and moving portrait of family dysfunction that balances belly laughs with genuine heart.
